units.function: Filesystem tests for listing and persistently symlinking bundled or company-library Skills into Cursor's HOME-scoped Skill directory.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> @paperclipai/adapter-cursor-local Skill list/sync -> local filesystem and caller-supplied HOME; no Skill catalog persistence, provenance verifier, authorization, policy engine or execution sandbox.
units.keyDataModels: Agent/company context, desired Skill key, runtime name/source directory, persistent mode and missing/installed entry state.
units.lifecycle: List desired Skills against HOME/.cursor/skills -> sync selected source directories as persistent symlinks -> later Cursor executions discover them globally from that HOME.
units.testAssessment: Focused Vitest passed 2/2. It validates only missing-to-installed happy paths. No collision, replacement, removal, rollback, source mutation, traversal, concurrency, isolation, provenance, revocation or cleanup behavior is tested.
units.designRationale: Reuse Cursor's native Skill discovery and avoid copying content by linking centrally managed bundled/company-library Skills into the user's Cursor home.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs governed Connector capabilities/instructions whose exact immutable version, license, publisher, human approval, tool/data scope and Run usage are provable and revocable.
units.companyOsFit: REJECT the persistent global-symlink lifecycle. Reimplement a content-addressed, signed Skill/Plugin artifact registry and materialize an immutable allowlisted set into a per-Run execution root. Record digest/license/publisher/approval/capability scope in the responsibility chain and implement atomic install/revoke/cleanup with collision and race tests.
units.responsibilityConflict: Agent/company IDs are metadata only; they do not scope the destination. A persistent mutable Skill can silently affect later Agents/Runs without a new accountable-human decision or evidence of the exact instruction version used.
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL cross-context instruction risk: destination is global HOME/.cursor/skills and lacks company/Agent/Run namespace despite those IDs appearing in context. HIGH supply-chain gap: arbitrary source directories are symlinked without digest/signature/license/provenance/content validation. HIGH revocation gap: persistent links survive Runs and no removal/rollback/cleanup test exists. Missing adversarial cases include path traversal, malicious runtimeName, preexisting symlink/file, source replacement after link, dangling links, concurrent tenants and permission failures.
